parts.name: Switch (Right Handle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right switch handle of the faucet, made of stainless steel, typically used to control water flow or temperature.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to turn on/off or adjust the water flow by rotating or lifting the handle.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or tilts around a fixed axis to open or close the internal valve.

parts.name: Switch (Left Handle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left switch handle of the faucet, made of stainless steel, used to control the other water line (hot or cold).
parts.Functional_description: It regulates the flow of either hot or cold water depending on the plumbing configuration.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or tilts to adjust the valve position, controlling water flow.

parts.name: Frame (Base Body)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main frame or base body of the faucet, made of brass, which connects the spout and handles to the plumbing system.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the internal valves and channels that mix and direct water flow from the supply lines to the spout.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the structural support for the faucet assembly.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: This is the spout of the faucet, made of stainless steel, through which water exits.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the mixed water from the internal chamber to the sink area.
parts.Movement_description: It may swivel horizontally in some designs, but typically remains fixed in this type of faucet.
